summary: The smallest complete game: a 15-second 'catch the stars' round launched from the lobby's Play button, with a leaderboard score.
description: A tiny game of its own mode (React/DOM, no engine): tap as many stars as you can in 15 seconds, gold stars are worth 3. The score goes to the title's leaderboard, and a round counts for quests that ask for games_played, for timed events that pay for the 'play_round' action and for season chains open to clients. The platform gives it to a new title when no other game fits the idea — it shows where a game plugs into the base (sign-in → lobby → Play) and is meant to be replaced by the real game. No demo settings of its own: it plays on the base's world.
provides: a small tap game launched from the lobby
rounds counted by quests, events and the season
placeholder game to replace with the real one
